purpose: Select durable data substrates for node artifacts, local state, analytics, product backends, vector memory, and schema adapters.

capability_types.name: Local State Store
capability_types.use_when: A node run needs durable local state, checkpoints, artifact indexes, or small relational data without a server.
capability_types.avoid_when: The workload needs high-concurrency distributed writes or managed permissions.

capability_types.name: Analytical Workspace
capability_types.use_when: Radar and Normalize outputs need fast local SQL analysis over CSV, Parquet, JSON, or tabular artifacts.
capability_types.avoid_when: The primary need is multi-user product state or long-running transactional services.

capability_types.name: Vector Memory
capability_types.use_when: Context, Radar, or Learning nodes need semantic retrieval over notes, artifacts, documents, or multimodal embeddings.
capability_types.avoid_when: Exact relational queries and transactions are the main requirement.

capability_types.name: Product Backend
capability_types.use_when: A real user-facing system needs auth, permissions, realtime features, storage, and a Postgres-backed app database.
capability_types.avoid_when: The task is a lightweight local run or isolated analysis.

capability_types.name: Schema Adapter
capability_types.use_when: A project needs typed DB access, migrations, generated clients, or application-level data model discipline.
capability_types.avoid_when: Direct SQL or simple local scripts are enough.
